facts.fact: La Gazette des Comores reports the incubator Comor'Lab / ACTIC launched the Wamanga wa Komor programme in April 2026, training 100 young people and funding 10 finalists who continue incubation at Comor'Lab.
La Gazette des Comores reports the Technopole Numérique, four months into its pilot phase, trained 34 first-year IUT students in a four-week web-development course with 10 trainers.

APIL Comores names two Comorian incubators, Innov'lab and OUSSAID, as leading innovation players that took part in the EBN BIC Africa soft-landing programme in France, with no programme or cohort of their own described.
Innov'Lab, an incubator created by the UCCIA and launched in February 2017, runs pre-incubation, two-year incubation and acceleration programmes and has incubated more than 60 firms.
